public_rationale: TechCrunch reported in October 2023 that Rabbit is a rebranding of Cyber Manufacture Co. It named Jesse Lyu and Alexander Liao as Rabbit's founders. Protos, writing before the post, said Lyu was CEO of Cyber Manufacture, GAMA's parent company, before it rebranded to Rabbit Inc. in October 2023. Rabbit's own spokesperson later said Rabbit and GAMA were separate ideas from the same company. Rabbit makes the r1. So the core claims hold: Lyu led GAMA's company, he co-founded Rabbit, and Cyber Manufacture and Rabbit are one company. The weakest part is 'is' CEO of GAMA. Rabbit says Lyu left GAMA. The claim holds only because GAMA belonged to the same company Lyu still heads.
limitations: The state filing for the name change was not read directly. Same-company evidence comes from news reports and Rabbit's spokesperson.
The present-tense 'is CEO of GAMA' depends on an interpretation the speaker did not spell out.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: Jesse Lyu was and is the CEO of GAMA and is the co-founder of Rabbit, maker of the purportedly AI-powered R1 device, and Cyber Manufacture Co. is the same company as Rabbit Inc.

statement.excerpt: I’m talking about it because the CEO of GAMA was and is Jesse Lyu, the co-founder of Rabbit, the company that makes the purportedly AI-powered R1 device, and that Cyber Manufacture Co. is the same company as Rabbit Inc.

from_speaker: the CEO of GAMA was and is Jesse Lyu
the company that makes the purportedly AI-powered R1 device
Cyber Manufacture Co. is the same company as Rabbit Inc.
our_interpretation: GAMA was a project of Cyber Manufacture Co., not a separate company. So 'CEO of GAMA ... is' is read as: Lyu headed the company that ran GAMA, and he still heads that same company, now named Rabbit Inc.
'Co-founder' is satisfied if reliable sources name Lyu as a founder of Rabbit, whether alone or with others.
'Same company' means one corporate entity that was renamed, not merely a shared team.
criteria.support_condition: Reliable sources show that Cyber Manufacture Co. was renamed Rabbit Inc., that Lyu led Cyber Manufacture (GAMA's parent company), that Lyu founded or co-founded Rabbit, and that Rabbit makes the R1.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Reliable sources show that Rabbit Inc. and Cyber Manufacture Co. are separate legal entities, or that someone other than Lyu led GAMA's company, or that Lyu did not found Rabbit.
